declared_totals.description: Counts this scout claims to have covered; reconciled against baseline.

records_count.description: Must equal records.length; cross-checks the declared_totals payload against actual output.

kind.description: Closed vocabulary. A new record kind is a deliberate schema change, not a typo.

verdict.description: Claim-check outcome, on `claim` and `coverage-gap` records only: did the documented assertion hold against the tree? Deliberately NOT the phase-3 vocabulary in verdict.schema.json — a scout can report `incomplete` (the claim is partly true), which no adversarial verdict may be, and it has no `confirmed_lower_severity` because a scout assigns no severity.

distinct_definitions_for_name.description: How many separate definitions in the tree share this record's bare name. >1 is the same-name-collision trap: an apparent caller may be calling something else entirely.

name_ambiguous.description: Shorthand for distinct_definitions_for_name > 1, so a consumer can filter without arithmetic.

integration_refs.description: References from build-tagged integration tests. Tracked apart from ref_sites because they do not compile in a default build, so they neither prove liveness nor prove death on their own.

test_only.description: Every external reference is from a _test.go file. Present only when true.

note.description: Scout-authored qualifier on this record, e.g. the migration that dropped a table or a name collision the counts alone do not explain.
